item.title: Week 11: Saints at Bears
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -11.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CHI 85% vs. market 82% | The game may turn on whether Chicago can keep pounding right tackle, where it runs on 19% of designed carries and New Orleans allows 6.5 yards per carry, third-most in the league. Caleb Williams, ranked 4th among quarterbacks, gets to face Tyler Shough, who ranks 18th, and that gap is the most visible one on the field. Our model sits close to the market, with Chicago at 85% against the market's 82%, and the rushing matchup drives most of the difference.
